items.description: This capability analyzes relationships among changes, dependencies, events, and outcomes; inferred relations remain distinct from observed evidence.
items.name: Deterministic Causal Execution Graph
operating_mechanism: Collect versioned changes, dependency edges, traces, and observations.
Construct a typed graph and attach provenance to every edge.
Separate explicit evidence from inferred or temporal associations.
Trace impact or evaluate a counterfactual against a declared baseline.
Report uncertainty and missing evidence; correlation alone is not causal proof.

items.description: Candidate execution representation that records event identity, causal parentage, state transitions, and artifact versions to support trace reconstruction and deterministic replay.
items.name: Deterministic Causal Execution Graph (DCEG)
operating_mechanism: Record an execution identity, initial state hash, contract version, and event sequence.
Attach explicit parent/event references and mark inferred edges separately.
Canonicalize event records and compute content digests.
Replay the sequence against a pinned runtime and compare state/output digests.
Emit divergence points and missing-link diagnostics without inventing causal links.

items.description: Verification capability for determining whether a recorded execution can be replayed under declared conditions with equivalent state transitions and outputs.
items.name: Replay Determinism Verifier (RDV)
operating_mechanism: Pin the event log, input hashes, dependency versions, and runtime configuration.
Replay the same trace in an isolated environment.
Compare normalized state snapshots, output hashes, and event ordering against the reference.
Classify expected nondeterminism using declared tolerances rather than silently ignoring differences.
Produce a signed or hashed verification report with first-divergence details.
